title: Improving Facebook Ad Performance with Opportunity Score and Recommen...
description: Improving Facebook Ad Performance with Opportunity Score and Recommendations We discuss a new Meta product called Opportunity Score and Recommendations, which is a tool to help agencies and advertisers optimize their Facebook ad campaigns. The Opportunity Score provides a score from 0-100 that indicates how well your ads are performing, and it provides recommendations on how to improve the score and make your ads more effective.
